title: File:Berlin Wall segment at University of Massachusetts Amherst 2023.jpg
desc: The installation of a 12-foot segment of the Berlin Wall, painted by famed French artist Thierry Noir and donated to the university by the family of Eric Hanson. The wall segment is installed outside in an east/west direction on UMass Amherst campus.
